verdict.summary: The change correctly carries the target-CI parser's own uncapped refusal count into the normalized flow document and renders a validated, positive count on the Queue & flow card, including when the metric grid is empty. The new self-tests are non-vacuous and cover whole-input loss, partial loss, zero sealing, field absence, seam mix-ups, warning-budget floods, singular/plural rendering, legacy documents, hostile value types, surviving CI cells, and the empty-grid placement. Expected values are independently literal, and the executed-page harness exercises the actual renderer rather than relying on lexical assertions. I found no correctness, soundness, fail-closed, privacy, or workflow-security regression in the diff.
